narrative.summary: CVE-2024-4577 is a critical PHP-CGI OS command injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) listed in the KEV database.
narrative.affected_summary: One asset is affected: GOV-WEB-01 (hostname citizen-portal-01) running PHP 8.1.28, internet-facing, criticality 4. The installed version falls within the vulnerable range (>=8.1.0, <8.1.29).
narrative.exploit_summary: The vulnerability is listed in the CISA KEV (added 2024-06-12) with EPSS 0.99987 (percentile 0.99984). A public exploit exists; Exploit-DB entry dated 2025-06-15. Early-warning signals include a new KEV entry and a new public exploit detection on 2026-10-31 (both simulated).
narrative.why_it_matters: It is actively exploited elsewhere and present in our environment, making it a highest-priority remediation item.
recommended_actions: Upgrade GOV-WEB-01 to PHP 8.1.29 or later, or apply the vendor-provided mitigation.
Limit internet exposure of the affected service until the patch is applied.
Review the referenced sources for additional context before taking action.

validation.note: All 7 identifiers/versions/URLs found in the supplied input; no unsupported claims or commands.
